subject: Post-call recap + procurement window — proposed target signature and milestone owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + procurement window — proposed target signature and milestone owners

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the attachments we promised: ORION_MAP_v0.9 (first draft) attached.

High-level recap
- Mutual Action Plan attached: includes milestones, proposed owners, and three target gates (SOW sign, Prod access, Data onboarding).
- Proposed target signature date: 2028-08-24 (we picked that to align with your quarter-end procurement window; flag if that’s wrong).
- Dependencies you flagged: SOC evidence handoff, PO issuance, and legal review timeline.

Milestone highlights (proposed owners)
- Legal review complete: Liam O'Connor (Orion) / Redwood legal (Marissa) — target 2028-08-10
- Procurement approval / PO: Jamie (Orion) — target 2028-08-17
- Integration kickoff + credentials: Stephanie (Redwood) / Orion infra — target 2028-08-27

Next steps / asks
1) Please review ORION_MAP_v0.9 and confirm if the signature deadline of 2028-08-24 works for procurement. If not, propose the latest acceptable date.
2) Can you confirm Liam is the right legal point of contact and whether you need a redline before 2028-07-25?
3) If PO timing looks tight, let us know and we’ll surface options (short-term credit, invoice terms) for contingency.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: ORION_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (XLSX, 210KB)]

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated MAP once we have your inputs.

—
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0118

From: Jamie Park <jamie@orionhealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + procurement window — proposed target signature and milestone owners

Thanks, Karthik — good summary. Quick answers inline and a small change to the procurement dates.

On Thu, Jul 12, 2028 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the attachments we promised: ORION_MAP_v0.9 (first draft) attached.
> 
> High-level recap
> - Mutual Action Plan attached: includes milestones, proposed owners, and three target gates (SOW sign, Prod access, Data onboarding).
> - Proposed target signature date: 2028-08-24 (we picked that to align with your quarter-end procurement window; flag if that’s wrong).

We can do 2028-08-24 but realistically our procurement committee signs off the week before the 25th — PO generation will likely land on 2028-08-22, which means legal needs to be done by 2028-08-10 at the latest. If you can commit to that legal cadence, the signature/PO timing should hold.

Changes / notes
- Please move the "PO issuance" milestone to 2028-08-22 in the MAP (we need that in the doc for our finance team).
- Security questionnaire: we can accept the SOC 2 snapshot but will need the detailed controls matrix before integration kickoff. Liam will coordinate with your team.

I attached our procurement calendar to show blackout days (team offsites the week of 2028-08-06).

Attachments:
- [Attachment: procurement_window_calendar.ics (CAL, 2KB)]

I’ll loop in Liam directly on redlines. If we need to nudge the deadline, I’ll let you know by EOD 7/14.

Best,
Jamie Park
Head of Procurement | Orion Health
jamie@orionhealth.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ORION MAP — move owner for legal and confirm docs

Internal note (do not forward)
Karthik / Stephanie — quick internal sync after Jamie’s reply:
- I’ll take point on Redwood legal redlines (I'll coordinate with Liam). I can have an initial redline to Jamie by 2028-07-18.
- Stephanie, can you confirm the security controls matrix will be ready for Orion by 2028-08-03? If not, we should plan to escalate for prioritized support.
- We should update the MAP to reflect PO issuance = 2028-08-22 (Jamie asked for that explicitly). I’ll update owners in the master and push v1.1 to the shared Drive.

Short-term contingency: if Orion’s PO slips by >5 business days, recommend offering a 14-day invoice term and reserved capacity hold for 30 days to keep momentum. Approve?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals & Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + procurement window — proposed target signature and milestone owners

Jamie — thanks for the clarity. We updated the MAP per your ask and attached ORION_MAP_v1.1 (PDF) which shows:
- PO issuance milestone moved to 2028-08-22 (as requested)
- Signature/contract execution target: 2028-08-24 (aligned to your procurement cadence)
- Legal owner changed to Liam O'Connor; Redwood legal owner = Marissa Cole (initial redline planned 7/18)
- Security controls matrix target committed for 2028-08-03; Stephanie will follow up with a short Q&A doc in next 48 hours.

We can confirm Redwood will hold reserved capacity for 30 days from signature and offer a 14-day invoice term if PO slips beyond 5 business days — per Marissa’s note above.

Next steps
- Liam (Orion): confirm whether you want the redline or clean copy first.
- Jamie: if PO timing is green, can we schedule a 30-minute signature readiness call for 2028-08-20 to ensure finance/legal alignment?
- Redwood: we’ll push ORION_MAP_v1.1 to the shared Drive and update the HubSpot deal. Links below.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: ORION_MAP_v1.1.pdf (PDF, 190KB)]

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7281
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cORIONMAP
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder/DEAL-7281

Thanks — looking forward to the readiness call if that helps lock the PO.
